extra.reason: Implemented byte-safe SCPI program-message parsing with relative/absolute headers, indexed nodes, abbreviation matching, strings, numeric units, lists, and IEEE binary blocks; 26 parser tests pass.

Implemented typed CommandSpec/ParameterSpec registry with SCPI abbreviation matching, indexed header bindings, typed coercion, range/unit/enum validation, capability predicates, and deterministic command errors; 13 registry tests pass.

Implemented thread-safe bounded FIFO errors, -350 overflow behavior, standard SCPI error records/messages, SYST:ERR?/COUN? payloads, and command/execution/device/query SESR bit latching; 17 error/status tests pass.

Implemented IEEE 488.2 ESR/ESE/STB/SRE and SCPI operation/questionable condition, event, enable, positive/negative transition registers with error, MAV, ESB, MSS/RQS, operation, and questionable summary propagation; 15 status tests pass.

Fixed active SCPIInstrument *CLS so it clears queued errors and ESR/STB latches without clearing instrument values or ESE/SRE masks. Added direct and raw-TCP regressions proving the same connection remains responsive after *CLS.

Implemented and wired overlapped operation fences: *OPC latches SESR bit 0 only after prior work; ESE bit 0 drives ESB and SRE bit 5 drives MSS/RQS; *OPC? blocks and returns 1 without setting ESR; *WAI gates later program units; ABOR and failures resolve deterministically. Direct and raw-TCP tests pass.

Implemented active channel-aware acquisition states (idle, armed, waiting, sweeping, processing, complete, aborted), internal/manual/external/bus triggers, trigger delays, single/group/continuous/hold sweep modes, averaging, ABOR propagation, Operation Status conditions, and real INIT-to-OPC TCP handshaking; 10 acquisition tests plus socket integration pass.

Implemented active byte output queue with MAV propagation, partial reads, -410 query interruption, -430 query deadlock/capacity handling, ASCII responses, definite/indefinite IEEE blocks, REAL/INTEGER binary encoding, NORM/SWAP byte order, and exact 1 MiB fragmented TCP transfer; 12 output tests plus socket integration pass.
Completed all eight M1 parser, registry, error, status, synchronization, trigger/acquisition, regression, and binary output deliverables with active-runtime and raw-TCP conformance coverage.
Pinned N5222B and N5242B A.20.25 compatibility matrix with official sources, hardware configurations, applications, policy, and tests
Added validated A.20.25 command manifest, implementation-key introspection, model coverage reports, gap-failing CLI, and freshness tests
